faqCta.ctaDesc: Find clear, practical guidance on your rights and next steps in simple language.
faqCta.faq1A: Think of AI tokens as "word-coins". A typical chat burns thousands. We do the heavy lifting upfront, optimizing your prompt to get a complete strategy in one go. "Credits Saved" tracks that efficiency.
faqCta.faq2Q: Can I use this in court?
faqCta.faq2A: No. Advocat-Easy is an <bold>educational tool</bold>. We empower you to understand your rights and strategy so you can talk to a lawyer confidently, but this is not a substitute for professional counsel.
faqCta.faq3A: Absolutely. Your details and questions are encrypted and never shared publicly. We use them solely to generate your specific legal analysis during the active session.
faqCta.faq4A: Use <bold>Quick Chat</bold> for everyday doubts (e.g., "Is this rent clause legal?"). Use <bold>Case Advisor</bold> when you have a specific dispute and need a structured roadmap and evidence checklist.

ProFAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
ProFAQ.faq1Q: How do I get started with ADVOCAT-Easy?
ProFAQ.faq1A: Sign in or create a free account, then head to the Dashboard. From there, choose Quick Rights Chat for instant answers or Case Strategist to build a full legal roadmap for your dispute.
ProFAQ.faq2Q: Is the AI advice legally binding?
ProFAQ.faq2A: No. All analysis provided is strictly for educational and informational purposes. It is not a substitute for professional legal counsel from a qualified advocate. Always consult a licensed lawyer before taking legal action.
ProFAQ.faq3Q: What areas of law does it cover?
ProFAQ.faq3A: ADVOCAT-Easy focuses on Indian civil law — including property disputes, contract matters, consumer rights, family law, and tort claims. It does not handle criminal matters.
ProFAQ.faq4Q: What is the difference between Quick Rights Chat and Case Strategist?
ProFAQ.faq4A: Quick Rights Chat gives you fast, conversational answers to everyday legal questions. Case Strategist is a deep, structured analysis — you provide facts, evidence, and witnesses, and the AI produces a full strategic brief with citations, risks, and an action plan.
